data.body: **[P1] Recheck scope fatals after final resource shutdown.** A timed-out scope can publish a `VirtualMachineError` or `ThreadDeath` while `onInvocationEnd` or `ExecutionManager.close()` is still running. This direct return then acknowledges `PENDING`/`SUCCEEDED`, although the fatal was observed before `execute()` exited; only the daemon worker sees it. Store the selected result, close the manager, then recheck `scopeFatal` immediately before returning or rethrowing. Update the late-fatal regression to require caller propagation.
